name: night-signal

subject.name: Night Signal
subject.audience: Festival-goers on a phone, in the dark, in a crowd, between stages
subject.primaryJob: Find who plays where right now
sources: The stages themselves: lighting rigs, truss construction and the colored wash each stage throws
The city after dark: sodium streetlight, neon signage, wet asphalt
The set-time board: a grid of stages against hours

principles: Construction made visible: rules and outlines carry the structure, as truss carries a stage
Primary forms: square edges and plain blocks, no ornament
Type as construction: a geometric display face set large
Color as a system of relations, not decoration
No confetti, squiggles, pastel clash or play for its own sake

territories.name: City after dark
territories.description: The streets around the festival at night: point sources of colored light on asphalt, each stage a glow you navigate by.
territories.light: colored point sources in darkness; the page is the night, the stages are the light
territories.composition: a grid of stages against time; one bright now-playing block
territories.imagery: light on structure, never photographs of crowds

muse.name: Sonia Delaunay
muse.take: Simultaneous contrast: colors set side by side so their relation, not any one hue, carries the rhythm
muse.leave: Her discs and arcs as motifs, and the painterly fabric look

samples.error: No signal. Times shown are from 22:40.

signature.reason: Delaunay's simultaneous contrast: the stages are known by how their colors sit against one another, so the accent hues are spread in a triad rather than one accent

avoid: Red, yellow and blue primaries used as decoration

rationale.form.scale: Used one-handed in a moving crowd at night: larger text and targets.
rationale.form.elevation: Departs from the night-city canon of floating glow: surfaces separate by outline and color, as Bauhaus construction would, and floating is the Memphis canon too.
rationale.color.character.harmony: The signature: stage colors related as a triad, after Delaunay.
rationale.color.character.emphasis: The now-playing selection has to read at a glance in the dark.
rationale.iconography.set: Phosphor bold holds up beside outlined controls and small on a phone at night.
rationale.grounding.primary: Reinterpreted for night: the primaries become stage light on a dark page, and construction shows as outline rather than painted shape.
